An event type can belong at most to one state group. All event types with the same state group ID are used to determine the state of a source. A source can be related to more than one state group.

Together, event types recording started and stopped in the recording state group determine whether the camera stream is being recorded.

data.name: MethodGetDevicePresetsToolTip
data.value: Should be called first with 0 as session ID and will then return a task. This task should then be looked up and once it is completed, it will report a new session ID. Now use this session ID in a new call to the original method, which will then report back with yet another task. Finally get this task to see the end result of the operation.
